datasets.name: CreditsInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   B.CREDITLINEAMOUNT
 , B.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE
 , B.ANNUALYOVERDUERATE
 , B.DATEOFCONCLUSION
 , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT
 , B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT
 , B.PURPOSEOFCREDIT
 , B.USRGROUP
 , B.CUSTOMERTYPE
 , B.CREDITTYPE
 , L.NAME
FROM
   CM_portfolio B
 , CM_BOOROWERINFO L
WHERE
     (B.ID =:CrdID)
 AND (L.CREDITID =:CrdID)

datasets.name: Tranches
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, tranchedate, trancheamount
  FROM cm_tranches
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID 
order by tranchedate

datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira,  id ,
        creditid ,
        paydate , 
        payedamt , 
        payedintamt,
        payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt, 
       payedpenaltyamt,
    payedamt + 
        payedintamt+
        payeddueamt+
       payeddueintamt+ 
       payedpenaltyamt as sm

  FROM cm_payments 
WHERE (CreditID=:CrdID)
order by paydate desc

datasets.name: Schedule
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira, id, creditid, paymentdate, 
    principal, 
    interest,
    principal+interest as sm
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
order  by paymentdate

datasets.name: RestsInPeriod
datasets.sql:
SELECT hdate,rest, interestrest,
       duerest, dueinterestrest,dueday
  FROM cm_history
  where creditid=:crdid 
    and hdate between :D1 and :D2 
order by hdate desc

datasets.name: IntrInPeriod
datasets.sql:
SELECT  hdate,trunc(interest,2) interest, dueinterest
  FROM cm_interests
 WHERE creditid=:crdid 
   AND hdate between :D1 and :D2 
order by hdate desc

datasets.name: ReportDataSet
datasets.sql:
select  
        A.contractaccid,
        P.boorowerid,(select tek_dat from sysdat) dat,
        p.currency,
        P.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.creditlineamount,
        c.name,p.annualyinterestrate,
       c.inn,h.rest,
        v.val_name/*,
        
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.booroweraccid) as clientaccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.contractaccid) as contractacccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.interestaccid) as interestacccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.dueloanaccid) as dueloanaccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.dueinterestaccid) as dueinterestaccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.loanaccid) as loanaccAccno*/
        
from  CM_ACCOUNTS A,
      cm_PORTFOLIO P,cm_curr_state h,
      customers c,
      avalute v     
where 
      (P.id = :CrdId)and 
      (A.creditid = P.id)and
      (c.id = p.boorowerid)and
      (v.valute = p.currency)  and
      (p.id=h.creditid)

datasets.name: RatesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select
  Ostat   as Rate
from
  OPERKURS
where
  Dat = :Dat   and
  Val_Kod = :CurrencyID

datasets.name: AboutBank
datasets.sql:
select
  az_Name as FullBankName,
  Logo ,
  INN,
  MANAGERTITLE
from BANKINFO

datasets.name: ProlongationDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT  prolongdate, newclosedate
  FROM cm_prolongations
where creditid =:CrdID

datasets.name: DefIntDatSet
datasets.sql:
select stopcalcdate from cm_curr_state
where creditid=:CrdID

datasets.name: cust
datasets.sql:
select p.numberofcredit,b.name from cm_portfolio p, CM_BOOROWERINFO b
where p.id=b.creditid 
and p.id=:id

datasets.name: DataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum,-2, c.ID creditid, b.NAME user1, c.dateofconclusion hdate,
        c.insertdat sysdat, '' oldparam, 'KREDITI DAXIL EDEN' newparam,
        'Daxil edən' polya, 'USID' polyaen, 'CM_PORTFOLIO' tablename
   FROM cm_portfolio c, smart.user$ b
  WHERE c.ID = :id AND c.usid = b.ID
 union 
 SELECT rownum+1, -1, c.ID creditid, b.NAME user1, c.dateofconclusion hdate,
        c.postdate sysdat, '' oldparam, 'KREDITI TESDIQ EDEN' newparam,
        'Təsdiq edən' polya, 'POSTUSER' polyaen, 'CM_PORTFOLIO' tablename
   FROM cm_portfolio c, smart.user$ b
  WHERE c.ID = :id AND c.postuser = b.ID
 union 
 SELECT rownum+2, a.id, a.creditid, a.user1, a.hdate, a.sysdat, a.oldparam,
        a.newparam, a.polya, a.polyaen, a.tablename
   FROM cm_portfolio_update a
 where a.creditid=:id

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.creditid, a.hdate, a.enddat, a.interest, a.dueinterest,
       a.status
  FROM cm_endcalac a where creditid=:creditid
and a.enddat in (SELECT max(enddat)
  FROM cm_endcalac  where creditid=:creditid)
